patterns: Where do students live on campus?
Do freshmen have to live on campus?
responses: EMU offers a variety of on-campus housing options, including traditional dorms and suite-style living. Freshmen are generally required to live on campus.
You can request a roommate or be assigned one. Single rooms may be available based on demand and accommodations.
All residence halls are within walking distance of classes, and include amenities like Wi-Fi, lounges, and laundry facilities.

patterns: How is the food on campus?
Are there vegetarian or vegan options?
Where can I eat on campus?
Do meal plans work at campus cafes?
responses: EMU has a full-service dining hall with multiple meal plan options. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices are available daily.
Meal plans can be used at the main cafeteria and campus cafes. You can choose a plan that fits your schedule and budget.
The food is prepared fresh and includes rotating menus, themed meals, and special events throughout the semester.

patterns: Is there a list of student groups?
Can I start my own club?
What are some popular student activities?
responses: EMU has a wide range of student organizations, from academic clubs to cultural groups and service organizations.
You can browse and join clubs through our student life portal. If you don’t see one you like, you can even start your own!
Getting involved is easy—club fairs and organization meetups happen regularly throughout the semester.

patterns: Is there a fitness center on campus?
How can I participate in sports?
responses: EMU offers varsity sports, club teams, and intramural leagues. There's something for every skill level.
Our fitness center includes cardio machines, weights, and group classes. All students have free access.
Whether you want to compete or just stay active, you’ll find plenty of athletic and wellness opportunities here.

patterns: Are there fun things to do?
Is there anything happening this weekend?
Does EMU host concerts or shows?
What’s student life like on weekends?
responses: EMU hosts concerts, speaker events, game nights, and cultural festivals throughout the year.
Weekends are lively with sports games, movie nights, and club-hosted activities. There's always something going on!
You can find a calendar of upcoming events on the campus life section of our website.

patterns: Can I have a car on campus?
responses: Yes, students can bring cars. A parking permit is required and can be purchased through campus security.
EMU provides designated parking lots for students, faculty, and visitors.
Bikes are welcome, and we also have bike racks and walking-friendly pathways across campus.

patterns: What safety measures are in place?
Who do I call in an emergency?
responses: EMU is committed to campus safety. We have 24/7 campus security, emergency alert systems, and blue light phones across campus.
In case of emergency, contact campus security at (555) 123-4567 or use a blue light phone located throughout campus.
Students also have access to safety escorts and secure residence hall access.

patterns: Can I have guests in my dorm?
What are the rules in the residence halls?
Do I have to clean my room?
responses: Residence halls observe quiet hours to support academic success. Guests are allowed but must follow the visitation policy.
Pets are not allowed, except for approved service animals. Students are responsible for keeping their rooms clean and tidy.
You’ll receive a full list of policies during move-in or during your housing orientation.

patterns: Do I have to pay for laundry?
Is there a laundry room in the dorm?
Are there study rooms or lounges?
responses: Each residence hall has laundry facilities. The cost is included in your housing fee or paid via campus card.
There are study lounges, computer labs, and community spaces available in many dorms and academic buildings.
Most common areas are open late for student use and have Wi-Fi access.
